pages.title: Cue and response
pages.text: The Bomber uses a fused explosion. Retreat during the fuse before returning to strike. Detonation also invokes a separate area of Pharaoh’s Curse around it;

pages.title: Cue and response
pages.text: surviving the blast does not imply avoiding that additional effect. Avoid letting it approach in a narrow passage.

pages.title: Ordinary combat
pages.text: This profile does not use hosted preparation. Fight it normally rather than looking for Start. Defeating this enemy contributes to world-tier progression.

pages.title: Loot and use
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Ancient Sandstone Shard, gunpowder. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.
